info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Operational Service Internal Bank Accounts-spec
info.description: The Retrieve Internal Bank Accounts API allows users to access the internal bank accounts managed by the operational service. This endpoint serves financial institutions or internal departments that need to view account details for operational purposes. Key functionalities include listing account balances, statuses, and associated metadata. It is designed for developers looking to integrate banking operational data into financial applications or reporting tools.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve detailed information about internal bank accounts within the operational services. It returns relevant account details such as account number, account type, and associated bank details.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information about internal bank accounts through the operational services. It contains the necessary parameters in JSON format to specify the request details.

200.description: The request was successful and the internal bank account data is returned.
